result.stdout:
Budget App Source (Prototype)
Read, resolve, upload, and compile Business Central app packages.

Usage: bas <command> [<subcommand>] [options]

Commands:
  artifact   Resolve Business Central artifact selectors.
  auth       Authenticate with Budget App Source.
  package    Read, find, and upload Business Central app packages.
  update     Update the global Budget App Source CLI tool from NuGet.org.
  version    Show the installed Budget App Source CLI version.
  workspace  Read, resolve, and compile Business Central workspaces.

Run 'bas <command> [<subcommand>] --help' for command-specific help.

Environment variables:
  BAS_ACCESS_TOKEN   Override the access token for CI/CD pipelines.
  BAS_URL            Override the configured web app URL.

result.stdout:
Authenticate with Budget App Source.

Usage: bas auth <command> [options]

Available commands:
  login   Authenticate and securely cache credentials for Budget App Source.
  logout  Clear securely cached Budget App Source credentials.
  token   Print the current Budget App Source access token to standard output.

Run 'bas auth <command> --help' for command-specific help.

result.stdout:
Read, find, and upload Business Central app packages.

Usage: bas package <command> [options]

Available commands:
  find       Find non-Microsoft Business Central app packages below a folder.
  read       Read metadata from one Business Central app package and write it as JSON.
  read-many  Read package paths from standard input and write their metadata as a JSON array.
  upload     Upload non-Microsoft Business Central app packages to a domain.

Run 'bas package <command> --help' for command-specific help.

Read, resolve, and compile Business Central workspaces.

Usage: bas workspace <command> [options]

Available commands:
  compile  Resolve dependencies and compile all Business Central apps in a workspace.

  resolve  Resolve and download the packages required by a Business Central workspace.

Run 'bas workspace <command> --help' for command-specific help.
